description: The bar chart illustrates the number of tokens (in thousands) associated with different categories of research papers. The vertical axis represents the number of tokens, while the horizontal axis lists the categories. The categories include Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, Science, and Blogs. The highest number of tokens is observed in the Science category with 10,584 tokens, followed by Administrative with 6,472 tokens. Religion has 1,889 tokens, Science has 1,626 tokens, Fiction has 387 tokens, Law has 354 tokens, and Blogs have the least with 32 tokens. The bars are color-coded in sky blue, and the values are labeled at the top of each bar. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on any of the bars.
